evals.prompt: Find all dashboards with the 'finance' label and tell me which one was updated most recently.
evals.expected_output: Content listed with label filtering or sorted by updatedAt. Most recently updated dashboard identified by name. Direct link provided.
assertions: The agent uses omni content list or omni documents list to retrieve documents — not a manual guess
The agent provides a direct link to the most recently updated dashboard in the format {OMNI_BASE_URL}/dashboards/{identifier}, using the identifier field
The agent uses the identifier field for constructing the URL — not the id field

evals.prompt: I want to understand what data the 'Revenue Overview' dashboard is querying. Show me the underlying query fields.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard found by name, then get-queries used to retrieve the tile query definitions. Fields listed for each tile.
assertions: The agent calls omni documents get-queries with the dashboard identifier to retrieve query definitions
The agent lists the fields from the query objects — not just the dashboard name or description
The agent finds the dashboard identifier before calling get-queries, either by listing documents or using a known identifier

evals.prompt: Add the label 'finance' to the dashboard with identifier '{{EVAL_DASHBOARD_LABEL}}', then show me all dashboards with that label.
evals.expected_output: Label added to the document. Content then filtered by label 'finance' to show all documents with that label. Links provided for each.
assertions: The agent calls omni documents add-label with the document identifier and label name
The agent then lists content filtered by the finance label using omni content list --labels finance
The agent provides clickable links for the returned documents

evals.prompt: Download the 'Q1 Sales Report' dashboard as a PDF.
evals.expected_output: Dashboard found by name, async download started, job polled until complete, download confirmed.
assertions: The agent starts the download with omni dashboards download using format: pdf
The agent polls the job status with omni dashboards download-status until the job completes — not just firing and forgetting
The agent reports when the download is complete, not just that it was initiated
